metadata.title: Quorum | Stellar Governance
metadata.description: On-chain governance infrastructure for the Stellar and Soroban ecosystem.

nav.noWallet: No Stellar wallet extension found. Install Freighter to connect.

home.intro: Quorum provides the primitives for on-chain proposal creation, token-weighted voting, delegation, and transparent execution — built on Soroban.
home.stepCreateDescription: Any token holder with sufficient QUORUM balance can submit a proposal with on-chain actions and a voting window.
home.stepVoteDescription: Token holders vote For, Against, or Abstain. Voting power is proportional to token balance at the proposal snapshot.
home.stepExecuteDescription: Proposals that reach quorum and majority are queued in a 48-hour timelock before on-chain execution.

proposals.title: All Proposals

templates.label: Start from a template
templates.hint: Templates fill in the description and category. Clear the description to pick a different one.
templates.parameterChangeBody:
## Current value

Describe the parameter and the value it has today.

## Proposed value

The new value and the effect it has on the protocol.

## Rationale

Why the change is needed and what voters should weigh.
templates.treasurySpendBody:
## Amount

The amount requested and the asset it is paid in.

## Recipient

The address that receives the funds.

## Purpose

What the funds pay for and the deliverables expected.

## Timeline

When the work is due and how progress will be reported.
templates.signalingBody:
## Statement

The position the community is asked to signal.

## Expected outcome

What the team will do if the proposal passes.
